description: Defines the EquationTextBox control class for the calculator app, including dependency properties, event handling, and UI state management.

classes.name: EquationTextBox
classes.description: Custom control for editing and displaying mathematical equations with UI state management and event handling.

methods.name: SetEquationText
methods.description: Sets the math text of the internal MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: FocusTextBox
methods.description: Attempts to set focus to the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Initializes template parts and attaches event handlers.

methods.name: OnPointerEntered
methods.description: Handles pointer entering the control area.

methods.name: OnPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exiting the control area.

methods.name: OnPointerCanceled
methods.description: Handles pointer cancelation.

methods.name: OnPointerCaptureLost
methods.description: Handles loss of pointer capture.

methods.name: OnIsAddEquationModePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual states when IsAddEquationMode property changes.

methods.name: UpdateCommonVisualState
methods.description: Updates the visual state based on focus, error, and pointer states.

methods.name: UpdateButtonsVisualState
methods.description: Updates the visibility of buttons based on current state.

methods.name: RichEditHasContent
methods.description: Checks if the MathRichEditBox contains any text.

methods.name: OnRichEditBoxGotFocus
methods.description: Handles focus gained on the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnRichEditBoxLostFocus
methods.description: Handles focus lost on the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnRichEditTextChanged
methods.description: Handles text change in the MathRichEditBox.

methods.name: OnDeleteButtonClicked
methods.description: Clears the MathRichEditBox content.

methods.name: OnEquationButtonClicked
methods.description: Raises event when equation button is clicked and updates tooltip/automation name.

methods.name: OnRemoveButtonClicked
methods.description: Removes the current equation and updates UI states.

methods.name: OnColorChooserButtonClicked
methods.description: Shows the color chooser flyout.

methods.name: OnFunctionButtonClicked
methods.description: Raises event for function button click.

methods.name: OnFunctionMenuButtonClicked
methods.description: Submits equation and raises function button event.

methods.name: OnRichEditMenuOpened
methods.description: Enables/disables context menu items based on current state.

methods.name: OnCutClicked
methods.description: Cuts selected text.

methods.name: OnCopyClicked
methods.description: Copies selected text.

methods.name: OnPasteClicked
methods.description: Pastes clipboard content.

methods.name: OnUndoClicked
methods.description: Undoes last change.

methods.name: OnSelectAllClicked
methods.description: Selects all text.

methods.name: OnColorFlyoutOpened
methods.description: Handles color flyout opening.

methods.name: OnColorFlyoutClosed
methods.description: Handles color flyout closing.

methods.name: OnHasErrorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual state when error state changes.

methods.name: OnEquationButtonContentIndexPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates tooltip and automation name when button content index changes.

methods.name: SetEquationButtonTooltipAndAutomationName
methods.description: Sets tooltip and automation name for the equation button.
